title: Reasoning and Tool-use Compete in Agentic RL: From Quantifying Interference to Disentangled Tuning
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical optimization of large language models (LLMs) to balance reasoning and tool-use capabilities within Agentic Reinforcement Learning. While it contains a brief 'Impact Statement' discussing general societal consequences of agentic intelligence, it does not evaluate or benchmark topics related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
